tickets.title: Compare charitable funding options for Paper Otter Literacy Fund
tickets.text: Prepare a side-by-side comparison of using cash, appreciated securities from Jonas Pebblefizz’s Velvet Acorn Custody account, and the existing Amber Teapot Charitable Trust donor-advised fund for the household’s $300,000 Paper Otter Literacy Fund commitment.
tickets.evidence: They agreed that the comparison is to be prepared by 2026-04-24.

tickets.title: Review taxable lots for in-kind charitable giving
tickets.text: Complete the taxable lot review for Jonas Pebblefizz’s Velvet Acorn Custody account, including the approximately $410,000 Marzipan Meadow Robotics holding and other positions with unrealized gains, for the in-kind charitable transfer analysis.
tickets.evidence: They agreed that the taxable lot review is to be completed by 2026-04-28.

tickets.title: Follow up on business-sale documents affecting gift timing
tickets.text: Follow up with Jonas Pebblefizz for the draft indication of interest, ownership schedule, and any transfer restrictions connected to the possible Copper Firefly Designworks transaction with Silver Marmot Holdings that are missing from the charitable analysis.

tickets.title: Follow up on donor identity for Paper Otter pledge and receipt records
tickets.text: Follow up on the donor identity for Jonas and Nadia Pebblefizz’s Paper Otter Literacy Fund pledge and receipt records. The draft pledge lists Jonas individually, while the household plan describes joint giving and a possible donor-advised fund grant path.

tickets.title: Follow up on Amber Teapot portal and account registration
tickets.text: Follow up on Jonas Pebblefizz’s Amber Teapot Charitable Trust portal and account registration. The prior grant request stalled after the portal rejected his login and sent a verification code to an old phone number, and the account profile may also carry the former mailing address.
tickets.evidence: Jonas reported that a prior donor-advised fund grant request stalled after the Amber Teapot portal rejected his login and sent a verification code to an old phone number, and the account profile may also carry the former mailing address; follow-up is needed by 2026-04-18.

tickets.title: Handle Paper Otter pledge package logistics
tickets.text: Handle Jonas and Nadia Pebblefizz’s Paper Otter Literacy Fund pledge package logistics, including the completed pledge package and initial transfer instructions. Address whether the household uses cash, appreciated securities, or a donor-advised fund grant.

tickets.title: Distinguish charitable funding before and after a potential Copper Firefly transaction
tickets.text: Distinguish funding for the Pebblefizz household’s charitable plan before and after transaction certainty for the possible Copper Firefly Designworks minority-interest sale. Account for the sale’s potential effects on household liquidity and concentrated business exposure.
tickets.evidence: the charitable plan has not yet distinguished funding before transaction certainty from funding after transaction certainty; follow-up is needed by 2026-05-08.
